title: Add Universal Cell Embeddings and the Evo 2 fixture checkpoint, corpus and benchmark (knowledge-graph dry run)
body:
Fixture issue for the intake agent's dry run with the knowledge graph. Only UCE and Evo 2 are real; the fixture checkpoint, corpus and benchmark are made up.

Primary sources:
- https://example.org/evo2-fixture/preprint-v1
- https://github.com/rewire-bio-fixtures/evo2-fixture
- https://example.org/evo2-fixture/variant-benchmark
